```{r location data, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#LOAD LOCATION DATA ----
monitor_community_info <- read_csv(here("data", "monitor_community_info.csv"))

# create spatial feature dataset of monitor points
#monitor_points <- st_as_sf(monitor_community_info, coords = c("geo_lon", "geo_lat"), crs = st_crs(4326))


monitor_points <- monitor_community_info %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("geo_lon", "geo_lat"), crs = st_crs(4326))


# LOAD IN THE COUNTRY AND REGION MAP DATA ----

country <- st_read(here("data", "spatial", "ghana_boundaries_shp", "gha_admbnda_adm0_gss_20210308.shp"), quiet = TRUE)

regions <- st_read(here("data", "spatial", "ghana_boundaries_shp",  "gha_admbnda_adm1_gss_20210308.shp"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
  rename(region = ADM1_EN)

bono_east <- regions %>% filter(region == "Bono East")


## SPECIFIC TOWN MARKERS ----

# just the lat/lon for kintampo
kintampo_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(
  location = "Kintampo",
  geo_lon = -1.7296,
  geo_lat = 8.0593
), coords = c("geo_lon", "geo_lat"), crs = st_crs(4326))

# Dwenewoho
dwenewoho_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(
  location = "dwenewoho",
  geo_lon = -1.8325,
  geo_lat = 7.7403
), coords = c("geo_lon", "geo_lat"), crs = st_crs(4326))


# New Longoro
new_longoro_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(
  location = "New Longoro",
  geo_lon = -2.02953,
  geo_lat = 8.14399
), coords = c("geo_lon", "geo_lat"), crs = st_crs(4326))

# Apesika
apesika_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(
  location = "Apesika",
  geo_lon = -1.5453,
  geo_lat = 7.99838
), coords = c("geo_lon", "geo_lat"), crs = st_crs(4326))

# Kurawura Akura
kurawura_akura_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(
  location = "Kurawura Akura",
  geo_lon = -1.4684,
  geo_lat = 8.7380
), coords = c("geo_lon", "geo_lat"), crs = st_crs(4326))

# techiman
techiman_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(
  location = "Techiman",
  geo_lon = -1.93350,
  geo_lat = 7.558700

# LOAD IN THE ROADS DATA ----
```

## Monitor Locations

```{r plot monitor locations, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define the bounding box coordinates
bbox_coords <- matrix(c(-2.2, 7.5, -2.2, 8.8, -1.3, 8.8, -1.3, 7.5, -2.2, 7.5), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
bbox_polygon <- st_polygon(list(bbox_coords))
bbox_sf <- st_sfc(bbox_polygon, crs = st_crs(4326))

# Plot the map with the bounding box
monitor_map<- ggplot() +
  # Add Ghana regions
  geom_sf(data = regions, fill = ifelse(regions$region == "Bono East", "#f5e493", "#dadbe0"), color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  # Add monitor points with transparency
  geom_sf(data = monitor_points, aes(geometry = geometry), color = "red", alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  # Add bounding box
  geom_sf(data = bbox_sf, fill = NA, color = "blue", lwd = 0.5, linetype = "solid") +
  # Add Ghana country boundary
  geom_sf(data = country, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1) +
  #labs(title = "Monitor Locations in Ghana") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11), # Increase axis text size
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1), # Increase tick mark size
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16) 
  )


# Save as high resolution PNG
ggsave("monitor_map.png", monitor_map, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)



monitor_map_zoomed <- ggplot() +
  # Add Ghana regions within the bounding box
  geom_sf(data = regions, fill = ifelse(regions$region == "Bono East", "#ffe493", "#dadbe0"), color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  # Add monitor points with transparency within the bounding box
  geom_sf(
  data = monitor_points %>%
    mutate(geometry = st_jitter(geometry, amount = 0.001)), 
  aes(color = monitor_type, shape = monitor_type),
  alpha = 0.6, 
  size = 4
) +
scale_shape_manual(values = c(
  "MOD" = 15,
  "MOD-PM" = 16
)) +
labs(color = "Monitor Type", shape = "Monitor Type") +
  
  # Add Kintampo marker
  geom_sf(data = kintampo_sf, aes(geometry = geometry), shape = 20, size = 3, color = "black") +
  # Add Dwenewoho marker
  geom_sf(data = dwenewoho_sf, aes(geometry = geometry), shape = 20, size = 3, color = "black") +
  # Add new longoro marker
  geom_sf(data = new_longoro_sf, aes(geometry = geometry), shape = 20, size = 3, color = "black") +
  # Add apesika marker
  geom_sf(data = apesika_sf, aes(geometry = geometry), shape = 20, size = 3, color = "black") +
  # Add kurawura akura marker
  geom_sf(data = kurawura_akura_sf, aes(geometry = geometry), shape = 20, size = 3, color = "black") +
  # Add techiman marker
  geom_sf(data = techiman_sf, aes(geometry = geometry), shape = 20, size = 3, color = "black") +
  
  # Add Kintamp annotation text
  annotate("text", x = -1.73, y = 8.10, label = "Kintampo", color = "black", size = 3.5) +
  # Add Dwenewoho annotation text
  annotate("text", x = -1.69, y = 7.74, label = "Dwenewoho", color = "black", size = 3.5) +
  # Add new longoro annotation text
  annotate("text", x = -2.047, y = 8.214, label = "New Longoro", color = "black", size = 3.5) +
  # Add apesika annotation text
  annotate("text", x = -1.459, y = 7.96, label = "Apesika", color = "black", size = 3.5) +
  # Add atta akura annotation text
  annotate("text", x = -1.65, y = 8.75, label = "Kurawura Akura", color = "black", size = 3.5) +
  # Add techiman annotation text
  annotate("text", x = -1.80350, y = 7.5587, label = "Techiman", color = "black", size = 3.5) +
 
   # Zoom in to the bounding box
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-2.2, -1.3), ylim = c(7.5, 8.8), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "",
       color = "Monitor Type") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11), # Increase axis text size
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5), # Increase tick mark size
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12), # Increase title size
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11), # Increase legend text size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12) # Increase legend title size
  )

# Save as high resolution PNG
ggsave("monitor_map_zoomed.png", monitor_map_zoomed, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)


map_combined <- monitor_map + monitor_map_zoomed
ggsave("monitor_map_combined.png", map_combined, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

## Grand Average plots 
```{r grand average facet, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# join daily PM into one dataset
daily_pollutants <- merge(daily_pm1, daily_pm25_grimm, by = c("date", "monitor"), all = T)
daily_pollutants <- merge(daily_pollutants, daily_pm10_grimm, by = c("date", "monitor"), all = T)

daily_pollutants$date <- as.Date(daily_pollutants$date)


# pivot longer data so each measurement is its own row 
daily_pollutants_long <- daily_pollutants %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise('Mean PM 1' = mean(mean_pm1, na.rm = TRUE),
            'Mean PM 2.5' = mean(mean_mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
            'Mean PM 10' = mean(mean_mod_pm10, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Mean PM 1", "Mean PM 2.5", "Mean PM 10"), names_to = "pollutant", values_to = "measurement")

# Calculate the mean values for each pollutant
mean_values <- daily_pollutants_long %>%
  group_by(pollutant) %>%
  summarise(mean_measurement = signif(mean(measurement, na.rm = TRUE), 3))

# Merge the mean values back into the original data frame for plotting
daily_pollutants_long <- daily_pollutants_long %>%
  left_join(mean_values, by = "pollutant")


# Convert the 'pollutant' column to a factor with the desired order
daily_pollutants_long$pollutant <- factor(daily_pollutants_long$pollutant, levels = c("Mean PM 1", "Mean PM 2.5", "Mean PM 10"))


facet_pm_time_series <- daily_pollutants_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = measurement)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = mean_measurement), color = "#cc1414", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(data = mean_values, aes(x = max(daily_pollutants_long$date), y = mean_measurement, label = paste0("Mean = ", round(mean_measurement, 2), " µg/m³")),
            color = "#cc1414", hjust = 1, vjust = -8, size = 4.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Pollutant Measurement (µg/m³)") +
  facet_grid(factor(pollutant, levels = c("Mean PM 1", "Mean PM 2.5", "Mean PM 10" )) ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
scale_x_date(
  date_breaks = "3 months",
  date_labels = "%Y-%m"
)+
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase axis titles size
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),    # Increase axis labels size
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14)  # Increase facet group text size
  )


# Save as high resolution PNG
ggsave("facet_pm_time_series.png", facet_pm_time_series, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```


```{r pm25 aqi plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

daily_pm25_grimm_date_mean <- daily_pm25_grimm %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pm25 = mean(mean_mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Define AQI levels with ordered factors
aqi_levels <- data.frame(
  ymin = c(0, 9.1, 35.5, 55.5, 125.5),
  ymax = c(9, 35.4, 55.4, 125.4, 225.4),
  fill = factor(c("Good", "Moderate", "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups", 
                  "Unhealthy", "Very Unhealthy"), 
                levels = c("Good", "Moderate", "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups", 
                           "Unhealthy", "Very Unhealthy")),
  color = c("green", "yellow", "orange", "red", "purple")
)

pm25_colors <- daily_pm25_grimm_date_mean %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean_pm25)) +
  geom_rect(data = aqi_levels, 
            aes(xmin = min(daily_pm25_grimm_date_mean$date), 
                xmax = max(daily_pm25_grimm_date_mean$date), 
                ymin = ymin, 
                ymax = ymax, 
                fill = fill), 
            color = NA, alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(color = "black") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +  
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = bquote("Fleet Mean " ~ PM[2.5] ~ (µg/m^3)),
       fill = "US-EPA AQI Risk Categories") +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),     
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11.5),     

    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),

    legend.position = c(0.77, 0.73),

    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),   # ↓ smaller color boxes
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),  # ↓ tighter vertical spacing
    legend.box.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),

    legend.background = element_rect(fill = rgb(1, 1, 1, alpha = 0.7), color = "black")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = aqi_levels$color) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m")

ggsave("pm25_colors_time_series.png", pm25_colors, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)


```


```{r pm25 aqi vertical stripes plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# First, categorize the measurement values into AQI levels
daily_pm25_grimm_date_mean <- daily_pm25_grimm_date_mean %>%
  mutate(AQI_Category = cut(mean_pm25, 
                            breaks = c(-Inf, 9, 35.4, 55.4, 125.4, 225.4, Inf), 
                            labels = c("Good", "Moderate", "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups", 
                                       "Unhealthy", "Very Unhealthy", "Hazardous"),
                            right = FALSE))

# Plot with vertical bands and legend on the side
pm25_vertical_stripes <- daily_pm25_grimm_date_mean %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean_pm25)) +

  # Background vertical stripes
  geom_tile(aes(y = 0, fill = AQI_Category),
            height = Inf,
            alpha = 0.3) +

  # PM2.5 line
  geom_line(color = "black") +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +

  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = bquote("Fleet Mean " ~ PM[2.5] ~ (µg/m^3)),
    fill = "US-EPA AQI Risk Categories"
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = aqi_levels$color) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +

  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m")

ggsave("pm25_vertical_stripes.png", pm25_vertical_stripes, width = 12, height = 3, dpi = 300)


```

```{r pm25 monthly bar plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

monthly_plot <- daily_pm25_grimm_date_mean %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    month = factor(format(date, "%b"), levels = month.abb),
    season = ifelse(month %in% c("Nov", "Dec", "Jan", "Feb"), "Harmattan", "Non-Harmattan")
  ) %>%
  group_by(month, season) %>%
  summarise(mean_pm25 = mean(mean_pm25, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = mean_pm25, fill = season)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +   
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Mean PM2.5",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Harmattan" = "goldenrod",
      "Non-Harmattan" = "grey70"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave("monthly_plot_pm25.png", monthly_plot, width = 6, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)
```

### HEATMAP CUSTOMIZATION

```{r heatmap customization, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## PM 25
hourly_pm25_grimm <- hourly_pm25_grimm %>%
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date)) %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("2023-09-21"))   

heat_map_data <- hourly_pm25_grimm %>%
  group_by(date, hour) %>%
  summarise(mean_pm25 = mean(mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    day = lubridate::day(date),
    month = factor(
  format(date, "%b"),
  levels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
             "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")
    ),
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    log_mean_pm25 = log(mean_pm25)
  )

pm_heatmap <- ggplot(heat_map_data, aes(day, hour, fill = mean_pm25)) +
  geom_tile(color = NA, linewidth = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#221f26", "#3f2363", "#872CA2", "#D44292", "#F98477", "#EDD9A1", "#fffceb"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 5, 12, 20, 40, 60, 100)),
    name = "PM 2.5\n(µg/m³)"
  ) +
  facet_grid(year ~ month) +
  scale_y_continuous(
  trans = "reverse",
  breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 3)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 10, 20, 31)) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Hour") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    strip.background = element_rect(colour = "white"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("pm25_heatmap.png", pm_heatmap, width = 17, height = 7, dpi = 300)


## PM 25 condensed

heat_map_data <- hourly_pm25_grimm %>%
  group_by(date, hour) %>%
  summarise(mean_pm25 = mean(mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    day = lubridate::day(date),
    month = factor(
  format(date, "%b"),
  levels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
             "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")
    ),
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    log_mean_pm25 = log(mean_pm25)
  )


pm_heatmap <- ggplot(heat_map_data, aes(day, hour, fill = mean_pm25)) +
  geom_tile(color = NA, linewidth = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#221f26", "#3f2363", "#872CA2", "#D44292", "#F98477", "#EDD9A1", "#fffceb"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 5, 12, 20, 40, 60, 100)),
    name = "PM 2.5\n(µg/m³)"
  ) +
  facet_grid(~ month) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "reverse", breaks = sort(unique(heat_map_data$hour))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 10, 20, 31)) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Hour") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(colour = "white"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
```

```{r heatmap road, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# helper to add calendar variables
add_heatmap_time <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      day = lubridate::day(date),
      month = factor(
        format(date, "%b"),
        levels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
                   "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")
      ),
      year = lubridate::year(date)
    )
}

# common theme
heatmap_theme <- theme(
  legend.position = "right",
  plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
  strip.background = element_rect(colour = "white"),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
  axis.ticks = element_blank(),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
  panel.background = element_blank()
)

# function for regular PM2.5 heatmap
plot_pm_heatmap <- function(df, fill_var = value) {
  ggplot(df, aes(day, hour, fill = {{ fill_var }})) +
    geom_tile(color = NA, linewidth = 0) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("#221f26", "#3f2363", "#872CA2", "#D44292", "#F98477", "#EDD9A1", "#fffceb"),
      values = scales::rescale(c(0, 5, 12, 20, 40, 60, 100)),
      name = "PM 2.5\n(µg/m³)"
    ) +
    facet_grid(~ month) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "reverse", breaks = sort(unique(df$hour))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 10, 20, 31)) +
    labs(x = "Day", y = "Hour") +
    heatmap_theme
}

# function for difference heatmap
plot_diff_heatmap <- function(df, fill_var = diff_pm25) {
  ggplot(df, aes(day, hour, fill = {{ fill_var }})) +
    geom_tile(color = NA, linewidth = 0) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166ac",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#b2182b",
      midpoint = 0,
      name = "PM2.5 Difference\n(N10 − non-N10)"
    ) +
    facet_grid(~ month) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "reverse", breaks = sort(unique(df$hour))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 10, 20, 31)) +
    labs(x = "Day", y = "Hour") +
    heatmap_theme
}

# -------------------
# 1. N10 heatmap
# -------------------
heat_map_n10 <- heat_n10 %>%
  add_heatmap_time()

pm_heatmap_n10 <- plot_pm_heatmap(heat_map_n10)

ggsave("pm25_heatmap_condensed_n10.png", pm_heatmap_n10, width = 12, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

# -------------------
# 2. non-N10 heatmap
# -------------------
heat_map_non_n10 <- heat_non_n10 %>%
  add_heatmap_time()

pm_heatmap_non_n10 <- plot_pm_heatmap(heat_map_non_n10)

ggsave("pm25_heatmap_condensed_non_n10.png", pm_heatmap_non_n10, width = 12, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

# -------------------
# 3. difference heatmap
# -------------------
heat_map_diff <- heat_n10 %>%
  rename(mean_pm25_n10 = value) %>%
  inner_join(
    heat_non_n10 %>% rename(mean_pm25_non_n10 = value),
    by = c("date", "hour")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_pm25 = mean_pm25_n10 - mean_pm25_non_n10
  ) %>%
  add_heatmap_time()

pm_heatmap_diff <- plot_diff_heatmap(heat_map_diff)

ggsave("pm25_heatmap_difference_n10_non_n10.png", pm_heatmap_diff, width = 12, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

## Harmattan vs non-Harmattan + Cooktime vs non-Cooktime

```{r pm25 trends harmattan and cooktime calculation, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
harmattan_start1 <- as.Date("2023-11-01")
harmattan_end1   <- as.Date("2024-03-01")

harmattan_start2 <- as.Date("2024-11-01")
harmattan_end2   <- as.Date("2025-03-01")

harmattan_start3 <- as.Date("2025-11-01")
harmattan_end3   <- as.Date("2026-03-01")

pm25_community_hourly_seasonality <- hourly_pm25_grimm %>% 
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    harmattan = ifelse(
      (date >= harmattan_start1 & date <= harmattan_end1) |
      (date >= harmattan_start2 & date <= harmattan_end2) |
      (date >= harmattan_start3 & date <= harmattan_end3),
      "Harmattan",
      "Not Harmattan"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cooking_period = factor(
      case_when(
        hour >= 17 & hour <= 20 ~ "Active Cooking Hours",
        hour == 3 ~ "Control Hour",
        TRUE ~ "Non-Active Cooking Hours"
      ),
      levels = c("Active Cooking Hours", "Non-Active Cooking Hours", "Control Hour")
    )
  )

# Harmattan only
harmattan_pm25_hourly <- pm25_community_hourly_seasonality %>%
  filter(harmattan == "Harmattan", !is.na(hour))

# Not Harmattan only
not_harmattan_pm25_hourly <- pm25_community_hourly_seasonality %>%
  filter(harmattan == "Not Harmattan", !is.na(hour))

# mean and sd pm25 during harmattan
mean(harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)

# mean and sd pm25 NOT during harmattan
mean(not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)


# COMPARING COOKTIME PM 2.5 ACROSS ALL SEASONS ----
anova_result <- aov(mod_pm25 ~ cooking_period, data = pm25_community_hourly_seasonality)
summary(anova_result)

# Tukey's Honest Significant Difference test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)
print(tukey_result)

# COMPARING COOKTIME PM 2.5 DURING HARMATTAN ----

anova_result <- aov(mod_pm25 ~ cooking_period, data = harmattan_pm25_hourly)
summary(anova_result)

# Tukey's Honest Significant Difference test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)
print(tukey_result)

# COMPARING COOKTIME PM 2.5 NOT HARMATTAN ----

anova_result <- aov(mod_pm25 ~ cooking_period, data = not_harmattan_pm25_hourly)
summary(anova_result)

# Tukey's Honest Significant Difference test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)
print(tukey_result)

# COOKTIME VS NOT COOKTIME COMP (MEANS AND SDs) -----

cooktime_pm25_hourly <- pm25_community_hourly_seasonality %>% filter(cooking_period == "Active Cooking Hours") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(hour)) 

not_cooktime_pm25_hourly <- pm25_community_hourly_seasonality %>% filter(cooking_period == "Non-Active Cooking Hours") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(hour)) 

control_pm25_hourly <- pm25_community_hourly_seasonality %>% filter(cooking_period == "Control Hour") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(hour)) 

mean(cooktime_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE) 
sd(cooktime_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE) 

mean(not_cooktime_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)  
sd(not_cooktime_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE) 

mean(control_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)  
sd(control_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)

# COOKTIME VS NOT COOKTIME VS CONTROL DURING HARMATTAN (MEANS AND SDs) ----

mean(harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Active Cooking Hours"], na.rm = TRUE)
sd(harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Active Cooking Hours"], na.rm = TRUE)

mean(harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Non-Active Cooking Hours"], na.rm = TRUE)
sd(harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Non-Active Cooking Hours"], na.rm = TRUE)

mean(harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Control Hour"], na.rm = TRUE)
sd(harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Control Hour"], na.rm = TRUE)

# COOKTIME VS NOT COOKTIME NOT DURING HARMATTAN (MEANS AND SDs) ----

mean(not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Active Cooking Hours"], na.rm = TRUE)
sd(not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Active Cooking Hours"], na.rm = TRUE)

mean(not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Non-Active Cooking Hours"], na.rm = TRUE)
sd(not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Non-Active Cooking Hours"], na.rm = TRUE)

mean(not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$mod_pm25[not_harmattan_pm25_hourly$cooking_period == "Control Hour"], na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r pm25 trends harmattan and cooktime plot//cooking time, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## PLOTTING THE COMPARISONS for two seasons between 3 time periods

base_plot <- hourly_pm25_grimm %>% 
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    harmattan = ifelse(
      (date >= as.Date("2023-11-01") & date <= as.Date("2024-03-01")) |
      (date >= as.Date("2024-11-01") & date <= as.Date("2025-03-01")) |
      (date >= as.Date("2025-11-01") & date <= as.Date("2026-03-01")),
      "Harmattan",
      "Non-Harmattan"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cooking_period = factor(
      case_when(
        hour >= 17 & hour <= 20 ~ "Active Cooking Hours",
        hour == 3 ~ "Control Hour",
        TRUE ~ "Non-Active Cooking Hours"
      ),
      levels = c("Active Cooking Hours", "Non-Active Cooking Hours", "Control Hour")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hour)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = harmattan, y = mod_pm25, fill = cooking_period)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    y = "PM 2.5 Concentration", 
    x = "Season",
    fill = "Cooking\nPeriod"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Active Cooking Hours" = "goldenrod", 
      "Non-Active Cooking Hours" = "#52b3eb", 
      "Control Hour" = "#b672e0"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Evening Cooking Hours (4pm–8pm)",
      "Other Hours (Excluding Evening Cooking\nand Control Hours)",
      "Control Hour (3am)"
    )
  )

## NOTE: USED RESULTS FROM ANOVA AND TUKEY TESTS TO DETERMINE SIGNFICANCE STARS. WILL NEED TO BE UPDATED DEPENEDING ON NEW DATA. 
plot <- base_plot +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0.72, xend = 0.98, y = 600, yend = 600), color = "black") +  # Harmattan Cooking Hour vs Not Cooking Hour
  annotate("text", x = 0.85, y = 605, label = "***") +

  annotate("text", x = 1, y = 625, label = "***") +

  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 450, label = "***") +
  
  theme(
```

```{r pm10 trends harmattan and cooktime calculation, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pm10_community_hourly_seasonality <- hourly_pm10_grimm %>% 
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    harmattan = ifelse(
      (date >= harmattan_start1 & date <= harmattan_end1) |
      (date >= harmattan_start2 & date <= harmattan_end2) |
      (date >= harmattan_start3 & date <= harmattan_end3),
      "Harmattan",
      "Not Harmattan"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cooking_period = factor(
      case_when(
        hour >= 17 & hour <= 20 ~ "Active Cooking Hours",
        hour == 3 ~ "Control Hour",
        TRUE ~ "Non-Active Cooking Hours"
      ),
      levels = c("Active Cooking Hours", "Non-Active Cooking Hours", "Control Hour")
    )
  )
```

```{r pm10 trends harmattan and cooktime plot//cooking time, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    date = as.Date(date),

      (date >= as.Date("2023-11-01") & date <= as.Date("2024-03-01")) |

      "Harmattan",
```

```{r main road regression, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
main_road_harmattan <- lm(mean_mod_pm25 ~ n10, data = harmattan_monitor_avg_pm25_grimm)

  harmattan_monitor_avg_pm25_grimm %>%
    mutate(season = "Harmattan"),

    mutate(season = "Non-Harmattan")

  )
```

```{r check data source, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  mutate(
    source_any = case_when(
      source_any == "cloud"   ~ "Cloud",
      source_any == "sd_card" ~ "SD card",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(monitor) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n_sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent = n_sum / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(source_any)) %>%
  mutate(source_any = factor(source_any, levels = c("Cloud", "SD card")))

df_plot <- df_plot %>%
  mutate(monitor = forcats::fct_rev(monitor))


p<- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = monitor, y = percent, fill = source_any)) +
  geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0,1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Cloud" = "#40c4c7", "SD card" = "#f4a09c"),
    breaks = c("Cloud", "SD card")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
    ifelse(x %in% new_fleet,
           paste0("<b>", x, "</b>"),
           x)
  }) +
  labs(
  x = "",
  y = "Percentage",
  fill = "Source\n(New fleet monitors in bold)"
) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )

# Save
ggsave("source_percentage_by_monitor.png", p, width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300)

```
